Change: Set calibrate.gamma to 1.0 (keeping group_by=instrument_class and scale=0.01 unchanged).

hypothesis: In the champion, coverage_in is 0.7896 (target 0.8). Reducing scale from 0.01 to 0.005 (exp_004) increased skill a little (+0.0368) but made coverage worse (0.758). Increasing gamma to 1.0 (exp_003) reduced skill sharply (0.0137). Calibration by series_id (exp_002) reduced both skill and coverage. Momentum+drift mean (exp_005) did not improve skill. In group fastgpu_daily|neocloud_spot, above_q90 remains high (0.161) and in gpurentalprices|neocloud_rate_card, above_q90 is 0.135, both with low below_q10: the tails remain asymmetric. Coverage by horizon is notably worst at 7d (above_q90=0.125, below_q10=0.092). -> Enabling calibration grouped by 'all' (i.e., global calibration) will help equalize tail coverage, particularly in groups where one instrument_class contains series with consistently high above_q90 and low below_q10. This may raise overall coverage_in closer to the 0.8 target, at a potential minor cost in skill on difficult series, but improving tail symmetry and calibration. Change: Set calibrate.group_by from 'instrument_class' to 'all'.
